name: Constraint
description: Constraint modifying the transformation of objects and bones

items.name: Copy Location
items.description: Copy the location of a target (with an optional offset), so that they move together

items.name: Copy Rotation
items.description: Copy the rotation of a target (with an optional offset), so that they rotate together

items.name: Copy Scale
items.description: Copy the scale factors of a target (with an optional offset), so that they are scaled by the same amount

items.name: Copy Transforms
items.description: Copy all the transformations of a target, so that they move together

items.name: Limit Distance
items.description: Restrict movements to within a certain distance of a target (at the time of constraint evaluation only)

items.name: Limit Location
items.description: Restrict movement along each axis within given ranges

items.name: Limit Rotation
items.description: Restrict rotation along each axis within given ranges

items.name: Limit Scale
items.description: Restrict scaling along each axis with given ranges

items.name: Maintain Volume
items.description: Compensate for scaling one axis by applying suitable scaling to the other two axes

items.name: Transformation
items.description: Use one transform property from target to control another (or same) property on owner

items.name: Transform Cache
items.description: Look up the transformation matrix from an external file

items.name: Clamp To
items.description: Restrict movements to lie along a curve by remapping location along curve's longest axis

items.name: Damped Track
items.description: Point towards a target by performing the smallest rotation necessary

items.name: Inverse Kinematics
items.description: Control a chain of bones by specifying the endpoint target (Bones only)

items.name: Locked Track
items.description: Rotate around the specified ('locked') axis to point towards a target

items.name: Spline IK
items.description: Align chain of bones along a curve (Bones only)

items.name: Stretch To
items.description: Stretch along Y-Axis to point towards a target

items.name: Track To
items.description: Legacy tracking constraint prone to twisting artifacts

items.name: Action
items.description: Use transform property of target to look up pose for owner from an Action

items.name: Armature
items.description: Apply weight-blended transformation from multiple bones like the Armature modifier

items.name: Child Of
items.description: Make target the 'detachable' parent of owner

items.name: Floor
items.description: Use position (and optionally rotation) of target to define a 'wall' or 'floor' that the owner cannot cross

items.name: Follow Path
items.description: Use to animate an object/bone following a path

items.name: Geometry Attribute
items.description: Retrieve transform from target geometry attribute data

items.name: Pivot
items.description: Change pivot point for transforms (buggy)

items.name: Shrinkwrap
items.description: Restrict movements to surface of target mesh

props.name: Override Constraint
props.description: In a local override object, whether this constraint comes from the linked reference object, or is local to the override

props.name: Owner Space
props.description: Space that owner is evaluated in

items.name: World Space
items.description: The constraint is applied relative to the world coordinate system

items.name: Custom Space
items.description: The constraint is applied in local space of a custom object/bone/vertex group

items.name: Pose Space
items.description: The constraint is applied in Pose Space, the object transformation is ignored

items.name: Local With Parent
items.description: The constraint is applied relative to the rest pose local coordinate system of the bone, thus including the parent-induced transformation

items.name: Local Space
items.description: The constraint is applied relative to the local coordinate system of the object

props.name: Target Space
props.description: Space that target is evaluated in

items.name: World Space
items.description: The transformation of the target is evaluated relative to the world coordinate system

items.name: Custom Space
items.description: The transformation of the target is evaluated relative to a custom object/bone/vertex group

items.name: Pose Space
items.description: The transformation of the target is only evaluated in the Pose Space, the target armature object transformation is ignored

items.name: Local With Parent
items.description: The transformation of the target bone is evaluated relative to its rest pose local coordinate system, thus including the parent-induced transformation

items.name: Local Space
items.description: The transformation of the target is evaluated relative to its local coordinate system

items.name: Local Space (Owner Orientation)
items.description: The transformation of the target bone is evaluated relative to its local coordinate system, followed by a correction for the difference in target and owner rest pose orientations. When applied as local transform to the owner produces the same global motion as the target if the parents are still in rest pose.

props.name: Sub-Target
props.description: Armature bone, mesh or lattice vertex group, ...

props.name: Enabled
props.description: Use the results of this constraint

props.name: Expanded
props.description: Constraint's panel is expanded in UI

props.name: Valid
props.description: Constraint has valid settings and can be evaluated

props.name: Active
props.description: Constraint is the one being edited

props.name: Influence
props.description: Amount of influence constraint will have on the final solution

props.name: Lin error
props.description: Amount of residual error in Blender space unit for constraints that work on position

props.name: Rotation error
props.description: Amount of residual error in radians for constraints that work on orientation
